Specification: This specification is a small error-triggering test module rather than a full algorithmic protocol. It defines a record constant Req whose field mask is set to the constant A, and then in Init it attempts to evaluate Req.mask[1], which applies the model value A as if it were a function; the surrounding Print calls indicate that the specification is intended to report an error at that point and not proceed further. The module also defines a trivial stuttering next-state action that leaves x unchanged and a trivial invariant Inv == TRUE, with no temporal specification, fairness, or fault-tolerance machinery.
FunctionApplication: Print("Should report error for applying model value to arg", TRUE)
Print("Should never get this far", TRUE)
